title: List the IDs of female patients diagnosed with SLE who had at least two lab
question: List the IDs of female patients diagnosed with SLE who had at least two laboratory tests showing low white blood cell counts (WBC < 3.5).

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_058" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014" WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F' AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE' AND T2."XCL_030" < 3.5 GROUP BY T1."XCL_058" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
